_comment: Copy this file to editorial.json (same folder) and edit it. editorial.json is gitignored because it contains personal names, dates, and messages — editorial.example.json stays in the repo as a template only.
_heroMediaId_comment: Set to a real media id to pick the homepage hero. Find ids by opening /api/media/manifest while logged in, or leave null for a designed fallback hero.
featuredCollectionDescription: Four years, countless photographs, endless laughter, and moments worth reliving forever. A personal collection of memories, created just for Varunika.
_featuredEpisodeOrder_comment: List of media ids (from the 'Moments to cherish' folder) in the order you want them to play as episodes. Leave empty to order by file date.

seasons.title: The Chaos Era
seasons.description: Hackathons, dance practice, and everything in between.

seasons.title: Core Memories
seasons.description: Trips, family, and the moments that stuck.

seasons.title: The Final Chapter
seasons.description: The last year, and the birthdays that mattered.

_seasons_comment: These folder assignments are editable suggestions, not facts about what actually happened each year. Reassign folders freely, or remove a season's folders list down to [] if it doesn't apply yet.
_profile_comment: Set photoMediaId to a real photo's media id to use it on the profile-selection screen. Leave null for a designed monogram avatar.

birthdayLetter.heading: Birthday Letter
birthdayLetter.body:
Dear Varunika,

Four years gave us so many memories, laughs, and moments worth keeping. This little corner of the internet is a collection of those memories and a reminder of how special they are.

Happy Birthday! Here's to all the stories still waiting to be written.

_birthdayLetter_comment: Replace body and from with your own words before sending this to Varunika. Or, for a rolling-credits-style letter instead of one static block, fill in messageParagraphs (shown one at a time) and closingLines (short final lines shown after it) — leave both as [] to keep the simple static body instead.

easterEgg.message: You found the secret. Happy Birthday, Varunika — here's to every story still waiting to be written.

_hiddenCollection_comment: Type the keySequence anywhere on the homepage to unlock this row. Add media ids you've deliberately chosen for it — the 'Funny calls' folder is a natural source, but nothing is added automatically.
_timeline_comment: Add milestones manually, e.g. { "id": "farewell-2025", "title": "Farewell", "description": "...", "date": "2025-05-01", "mediaId": "<id>" }. Dates are only ever shown when you supply them here — none are invented.

endCredits.heading: THE END?
endCredits.subheading: Every great story deserves a sequel.

_endCredits_comment: Add entries like { "mediaId": "<id>", "caption": "..." } to roll photos in the credits sequence. Or write a personal closing letter instead: messageParagraphs is an array of paragraphs shown one at a time like rolling movie credits, closingLines are short final lines shown after it (e.g. a sentiment, then a thank-you), and from is your signature. Write your own words — nothing here should be invented for you.
_soundtrack_comment: Set backgroundMusicUrl to a path under /public (e.g. '/audio/theme.mp3') once you've added a licensed or original track there.
